inserts_utc.description: Two transactions inserting every table, read with TimeZone UTC.

inserts_johannesburg.description: Two transactions inserting every table, read with TimeZone Africa/Johannesburg.

inserts_kolkata.description: Two transactions inserting every table, read with TimeZone Asia/Kolkata.

inserts_st_johns.description: Two transactions inserting every table, read with TimeZone America/St_Johns.

disbursement.description: An insert, a real disbursement update and a replayed one (REPLICA IDENTITY FULL).

default_identity_updates.description: Updates on a default-identity table: no old row, then a key change (old row of kind K).

delete_and_truncate.description: An insert, a delete (key-only old row) and a truncate. V1 produces neither of the last two.

unknown_type.description: A relation with a uuid column (type OID 2950), which the contract does not map.

unchanged_toast.description: An update that leaves an out-of-line (TOAST) column unchanged: the new tuple carries the 'u' marker.
